question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 to $108B +/-2%; consensus ~$108.8-109.2B. Over the last 8 quarters actual revenue beat the guide midpoint by 2.5-8% (median ~5%; Q2 FY27 +5.7%: guide 91, actual 96.2). Applied to $108B -> ~$110.7-116.6B, median ~$113B. Shaded slightly for Rubin ramp supply constraints and a softer macro/scandal backdrop (scandal doesn't affect a quarter that already closed). Upper escape (>$116B, a beat >7.4%) happened ~1 in 8 quarters, so ~10%. Below $105B would need a miss below guide, which hasn't happened in this era (~1%, not declared). No human prediction market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi).

- Q2 FY27 actual $96.2B vs guide $91.0B (+5.7% vs midpoint); data center $89.0B (Nvidia PR via stocktitan, Aug/Sep 2026).

- Nvidia gave unusual FY2028 guidance of 70% growth vs Street's 45% to fix a gap between Street estimates and internal visibility (Yahoo, Sep 2026).
- Headwinds: Jensen Huang admitted infidelity Nov 8, 2026; board investigating a possible foreign-intelligence targeting angle; Reuters says the relationship helped facilitate ~$7.5B of chip shipments to Chinese firms (IG Nov 10). Fed hiked in Sep 2026; neocloud stocks are down; incoming governors after the Democratic midterm wins say they'll restrict new data centers (Motley Fool Nov 10). The quarter ended ~late Oct 2026, so these mostly bear on later quarters.
- Tailwinds: CoreWeave Q3 revenue +170%, backlog $132.5B, quarterly capex $14.5B (CNA Nov 10, 2026).
- Status quo: revenue lands at or above the guidance range, as it has every quarter of this era.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: guide $108B ±2%, beat history 2.5-8%, consensus ~$109B, report on Nov 17 (not Nov 25; this doesn't change what resolves the question), and the quarter already closed. The disagreements were judgment only: the size of the upper tail (6-10%) and the median ($112.8-113.2B). The 7%+ beats came only in FY25 and recent beats clustered at 4.6-5.7%, so I set the median at ~4.7% over the guide and the upper escape at 8%. I carried forward Run 2's dispersion, since it matches the beat SD.
